narrative.text: The steel modernization has hit a wall. The construction workers — Veltrian laborers hired for the project — have walked off the job. Their demands: hazard pay for working near active blast furnaces, overtime compensation, and a guarantee that the modernized facility will not reduce the workforce. The contractor says the demands will add 8 million ₭ to the project cost. Gregor Marić is waiting in the Workers' Hall.

The workers are not being unreasonable. They are working next to furnaces that could kill them if something goes wrong. They want to know that the modernization — which they support — will not be used as an excuse to replace them with machines and Arcturian contractors. These are the men who built this foundry. They are asking you to remember that.

choices.text: "Negotiate. Meet their demands — hazard pay, overtime, workforce guarantee. It will add eight million and delay the project by two weeks. But the workers who build this modernization should not fear it."

"We cannot afford the delay. Offer a five percent wage increase — no more. If they do not return, we will hire replacement workers. The modernization must proceed on schedule. The country cannot wait for every grievance to be resolved."
